kind: offline finite synthetic lifecycle implementation review
registry_binding: separately committed and frozen; excluded from qualification execution digest
lease: shared register/USB/stream admission blocker, rotated before explicit recovery
serial_route: one CONFIG/START/DATA/END worker; independent saved replay in a separate bounded worker
known_closed_recovery: identical qualified tuple/runtime/original UID and baseline; no install or CONFIG/START
unknown_or_missing_closure: refuse device access and preserve lease; no override

actual_arm001_read_only_check.scope: Existing exact artifact/startup/image metadata checked read-only in original root context; not a new build or physical qualification

limitations: Tests use actual compiled-C protocol frames, regular files, processes and injected hardware adapters; no device operations.
Known-closed terminal recovery only. Unknown/crashed/missing receipts require independent resource investigation; no automated override.
Physical grade, measured clock, voltages, pin ownership/turnaround, loading/recovery and selected-transport rate/loss/timing measurements remain gates.
The admission clock includes persistence; OS calls and bounded cleanup can overrun an operation ceiling, which cannot qualify a late result.
